answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 150896 Country: India Title: Please send me safe pregnancy duas or wazifah. Question: Please send me safe pregnancy duas or wazifah. Answer ID: 150896 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 868/827/B=9/1438) Keep on reciting the following dua extensively: فَاللّهُ خَيْرٌ حَافِظاً وَهُوَ أَرْحَمُ الرَّاحِمِينَ . There is no number or time fixed for it, you may read it when you wish and you may read it as many times as you wish. In-shaAllah, you shall have a safe pregnancy. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
